program:

each routine
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it

program:
app "My Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1
  each ["Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day
"Saved on this device only." faint
describe:
My Journal, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- entry: mood: number, 1 to 5; note: long text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: d, a new entry being filled in; q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: "How are you feeling?".
- for "Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great":
  - a group; a tap sets the mood of the d to its position plus 1:
    - a drawing made of circles, rectangles.
    - text: the value.
- a box to fill in the note of the d, labelled "What is on your mind?".
- a button "Save entry"; a tap saves the new d.
- a big number: the current day streak of entry entries, labelled "day streak, including today" when how many entry entries today is more than 0, otherwise "day streak; write today to keep it".
- a big number: how many of the day in the last 14 days have how many entry entries on that day is more than 0, labelled "of 14 days written".
- for each day in the last 14 days:
- text: "Mood this week", the average mood of entry this week rounded, "vs", the average mood of entry last week rounded, "last week".
- a line chart of its mood over entry in the last 30 days sorted by at.
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search entries".
- if q is not "" and how many entry entries where note contains q is 0:
  - text: "Nothing found. Try a shorter word.".
- a list of entry where note contains q by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- text: "Saved on this device only.".
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Books for sale" book plum
table title_stock name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3
state q text = ""
let short = count(title_stock, it.qty <= it.low)
short "books running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each title_stock where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form title_stock
describe:
Books for sale, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- title stock: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the title stock have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "books running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each title stock where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the title stock for editing; a swipe removes the title stock, with undo:
    - text: the name of the title stock.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the title stock to the qty of the title stock minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the title stock.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the title stock to the qty of the title stock plus 1.
- a form to add a title stock.

program:
app "Spend Light Pro" bell slate
table spend amount money, note text?
setting limit money = 2000 "Daily spending limit"
let s = sum(spend.amount today)
row gap 2 align center
  draw 40, 120 width 70
    rect 5, 0, 30, 120 fill ink radius 8
    circle 20, 20, 11 fill if(s > limit, bad, soft)
    circle 20, 60, 11 fill if(s <= limit and s > limit * 0.8, warn, soft)
    circle 20, 100, 11 fill if(s <= limit * 0.8, good, soft)
  stack gap 1
    s big
    if(s > limit, "Over your limit", "Under your limit") "of" limit head
form spend, "Add spending"
describe:
Spend Light Pro, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- spend: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily spending limit": money, starts at 2000.
Works out:
- s is the total amount of spend today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of rectangles, circles.
- text: s.
- text: "Over your limit" when s is more than limit, otherwise "Under your limit", "of", limit.
- a form to add a spend.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Zikr" beads slate
table zikr
setting target num = 20
let n = count(zikr today)
draw width 240 tap add zikr
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Undo" tap remove last(zikr today)
button "Reset today" tap remove all zikr today
describe:
Zikr, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- zikr: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: target: number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- n is how many zikr entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a zikr.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest zikr entries today, with undo.
- a button "Reset today"; a tap removes all zikr entries today, with one undo.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Self care" heart slate
table ritual name text
table ritual_done ritual ref ritual
let n = count(ritual)
count(ritual_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each ritual
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
    toggle it.ritual_done
form ritual
stat round(count(ritual_done week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% done this week"
remind "Time to tick off self care" at 22:00
describe:
Self care, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- ritual: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- ritual done: ritual: a ritual. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many ritual entries.
Shows:
- text: how many ritual done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
- for each ritual:
  - a group; a tap opens the ritual for editing; a swipe removes the ritual, with undo:
    - text: its name.
    - a tick box for its ritual done.
- a form to add a ritual.
- a big number: how many ritual done entries this week times 100 divided by the result of n times the weekday number of today rounded, labelled "% done this week".
Reminder "Time to tick off self care" at 22:00 every day.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Pantry" food mint
table ingredient name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, price money?, kind pick Big|Small|Spare, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(ingredient, it.qty <= it.low)
short "ingredients running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each ingredient where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(ingredient, it.qty * it.price) faint
form ingredient
remind "Check your ingredients" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Pantry, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- ingredient: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10; price: money, optional; kind: one of Big, Small, Spare; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the ingredient have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "ingredients running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each ingredient where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the ingredient for editing; a swipe removes the ingredient, with undo:
    - text: the name of the ingredient.
    - text: the kind of the ingredient.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the ingredient.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the ingredient to the qty of the ingredient minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the ingredient.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the ingredient to the qty of the ingredient plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the ingredient.
- a form to add a ingredient.
Reminder "Check your ingredients" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with the problem or reason
